status: DRAFT for Murray's review (SCOPE.md B1). Each ALUM version 8 secondary class (CLUM December 2023) goes to exactly one of the model's five land types. The 2011 model took cropping and pasture from the ABS census land-use items, reserve from CAPAD 2008, infrastructure as an estimate (730 m2 per person) and non-agricultural as the remainder; this mapping measures all five from one raster.
choices_to_review: nature: 1.1 Nature conservation only, or with 1.2 Managed resource protection. 1.2 includes water catchments and other managed protection that CAPAD 2008 may not have counted.
cropping: whether land in transition (3.6, 4.6) and intensive horticulture (5.1) count as cropping.
pasture: grazing of native vegetation (2.1) is 3.6 million km2 and drives the national pasture figure; it is the rangelands, as in the ABS census 'grazing' land.
infrastructure: mining (5.8) is left in non-agricultural; the 2011 model's infrastructure was an estimate from population, not a measured land use.
water (class 6): kept in non-agricultural so that the five types sum to the SA2 land and water area, as the 2011 total area did.
